scene_text: Victor discovering Elizabeth’s lifeless body across the bridal bed, moonlight entering through the window as curtains and hair fall across her pale face.
In a dim laboratory on a stormy November night, the stitched creature opens its dull yellow eye under the flicker of a dying candle as Victor recoils in dread.
The monster grins at the open window, moonlight behind him, pointing mockingly at Elizabeth’s corpse before Victor fires his pistol.
By the dying candlelight, the creature’s dull yellow eye opens as Victor stands over the lifeless body he has just animated.
The Creature framed in the open window by yellow moonlight, grinning and pointing at Elizabeth’s corpse while Victor fires a pistol and the monster leaps toward the dark lake.
Victor wakes from a nightmare to see the Creature looming beside his bed, moonlight filtering through shutters as it pulls back the curtain and reaches toward him.
Elizabeth lies lifeless across the bridal bed, her pale face half veiled by hair while stormlight flickers through the dark room.
By moonlight in the laboratory, Victor tears the half‑finished female creature to pieces while the monster watches through the window with a ghastly grin.
In the moonlit laboratory, Victor tears apart the half‑finished female creature while the original monster grins through the window and watches in silent fury.
Victor alone at midnight in a cramped attic laboratory, moonlight through a window illuminating bones, dissecting tools, and a massive unfinished humanoid frame on the table.
The Creature dancing in manic fury around the De Lacey cottage as wind howls and flames climb the wooden walls into the night sky.
Across an endless white Arctic plain, a distant sledge pulled by dogs races north while a gigantic human-like figure stands silhouetted against the icy horizon.
In moonlight filtering through the shutters, the newly created monster pulls back Victor’s bed curtain and reaches toward him as he recoils in terror.
Victor wandering among open graves and charnel-house vaults with a lantern, studying decaying bodies while shadows loom over the damp stone walls.
Alone at night in a small skiff, Victor dumps a basket of dismembered body parts weighted with stones into the black sea as clouds swallow the moon.
Through a clearing fog on the endless Arctic ice, sailors watch a gigantic figure driving a dog sledge across the frozen plain.
At dusk near Geneva, the towering Creature grips young William in a shadowed field as the boy struggles and the mountains loom in the distance.
In a stormy night the Creature whirls a flaming branch and ignites the abandoned De Lacey cottage as wind drives the flames over the roof.
A storm-lashed lakeshore at night as Victor stands tense outside the inn, hand hidden on a pistol while clouds race across the moon.
Sailors haul a drifting sledge onto the ship beside broken ice floes, revealing a gaunt, half-frozen Victor Frankenstein wrapped in furs with a single surviving dog.
A half-dead man lies in a shattered sledge on a drifting ice floe as sailors haul him toward the ship while the Arctic sea churns around them.
The Creature confronts Victor in the dim room and delivers the chilling promise: 'I shall be with you on your wedding-night.'
